subject: Confirm your email for taai
headline: Welcome aboard.
body: Tap below to confirm your email and start planning.
foot: Didn't sign up? You can ignore this email.

sender: Edge function (new: send-lifecycle-email, on first confirmed login)
subject: You're in. Let's plan something good.
headline: Hi {{name}}, welcome to taai.
body: Start an itinerary, invite your travel crew, and ask Miles for ideas. Bookings happen with third-party providers; taai keeps the plan in one place.
foot: Questions? Just reply to this email.

sender: Edge function (stripe-subscription-webhook on checkout.session.completed) + Stripe receipt
subject: Your {{plan}} plan is active
headline: Thanks for joining {{plan}}.
body: You're on {{plan}} at {{amount}}/{{interval}}. Next charge: {{next_date}}. Your new limits are live now.
foot: Stripe sends your official receipt separately.

sender: Edge function (invoice.paid, billing_reason=subscription_cycle, interval=month) + Stripe receipt
subject: Your taai renewal went through
headline: Renewed. Thanks for sticking around.
body: We charged {{amount}} for another month of {{plan}}. Next charge: {{next_date}}.
foot: Manage or cancel anytime from Account > Billing.

sender: Edge function (invoice.paid, subscription_cycle, interval=year); 7-day pre-renewal notice via Stripe 'upcoming renewal' email
subject: Another year of {{plan}}
headline: Your year with taai starts again.
body: We charged {{amount}} for 12 months of {{plan}}. Next renewal: {{next_date}}.
foot: Questions about this charge? Just reply.

sender: Stripe (failed payment email + Smart Retries) and edge function (invoice.payment_failed)
subject: Your payment didn't go through
headline: Quick fix needed.
body: We couldn't charge your card for {{plan}} ({{amount}}). We'll try again on {{retry_date}}. Update your card to keep your plan.
foot: Your trips stay safe while we sort this out.

subject: Your plan changed to {{new_plan}}
headline: You're now on {{new_plan}}.
body: Moved from {{old_plan}} to {{new_plan}}. New price: {{amount}}/{{interval}}, starting {{effective_date}}. Any proration shows on your next invoice.
foot: Didn't make this change? Reply right away.

subject: Your subscription is cancelled
headline: Sorry to see you go.
body: {{plan}} stays active until {{end_date}}. After that you'll move to the free Traveler plan; your trips stay put (beyond 3 itineraries become read-only).
foot: Tell us why in one reply? It really helps.

subject: Your taai account is closed
headline: Your account is closed.
body: You've been signed out everywhere and any subscription was cancelled. We'll permanently delete your data on {{purge_date}} (30 days). Change your mind before then? Just sign in.
foot: Want it deleted sooner? Reply 'delete now'.

subject: Your data has been deleted
headline: All done.
body: As requested, we deleted your taai account, trips, chats, Miles memory and uploads on {{deleted_date}}. We keep only billing records required by law (up to 7 years) in Stripe and our ledger. Reference: {{request_id}}.
foot: This is the last email you'll get from us.
